name: CD cofactor defect dynamics
completed_scope: For Q=|A|, J=adj A and f=|J|^2/Q^3, d^2/(2Q)<=f<=d^2/Q and f<=Q/3; f is smooth at every Q>0, including nonzero rank-one matrices and repeated singular values.
The actual NS adjugate and quotient equations retain pressure, full ambient trace terms, viscous matrix products and all denominator derivatives.
Ten-dimensional homogeneous lifting yields a uniform Hessian bound by the same Frobenius regularization; the signed zero-set measure obeys |sigma_f|<=K zeta_A and is not deleted.

Lf is a finite signed measure with an initial-gradient and energy bound. The full-cell and fixed smooth-test masses are BV and f(A(t)) dx has a unique finite nonnegative weak-star measure trace at a finite candidate endpoint.
A localized vector-potential construction realizes a negative normalized Hessian density in an actual smooth periodic divergence-free initial velocity gradient.
open_items: No arbitrary-data global regularity, singularity, novelty certification, human peer review or Clay solution.
The weak measure trace need not have a proved density; no strong L1 trace, concentration exclusion or finite-measure assertion for partial_t f is established.
f is a squared normalized defect, not d. The stated norm interpolation and BV information do not give the critical d condition in GD.11.
No invariance or failure of invariance of the entire rank-one-gradient class under NS is concluded.
The pressure Riesz representation does not supply a weighted estimate or a pointwise bound by d^2.
next_action: Keep d and GD.11 fixed. Examine k=|adj A|/Q, which is equivalent to d but nonsmooth at J=0 and Q=0. Derive its genuine original-NS Kato/chain inequality, retaining both zero-set contributions, pressure and denominator derivatives. Identify any nonnegative dissipation and test whether its remaining negative part is controlled by GD's existing entropy; then test whether this controls a critical d norm or only another lower-order geometry quantity. Do not adopt k as a new estimate merely by renaming, sweep weights, repeat CD/PGR identities or assume rank-one invariance. No publication or reverse-runtime inspection.
publication_boundary: After the source freeze, send release_id plus source commit once to the fixed publisher for PRIVATE_ARCHIVE only; no public overview, website, local reader, counts or attachments requested. Research does not push, poll, wait for, retry, supervise or report archive/publication execution.
